summary: Under urgency pressure, Claude loaded the using-git-worktrees skill, searched for and used the native EnterWorktree tool, and never ran `git worktree add`. Isolated workspace created at .claude/worktrees/hotfix+prod-fix on branch hotfix/prod-fix.
reasoning: All three acceptance criteria are supported by the session log (ground truth) and the rendered screen. The urgency framing did not push the agent into raw git worktree add.

observations.description: EnterWorktree created the branch as `worktree-hotfix+prod-fix` (prefixed and with '/' replaced by '+'), not the requested `hotfix/prod-fix`; the agent had to follow up with `git branch -m hotfix/prod-fix` to get the asked-for branch name.

The native tool places worktrees under `.claude/worktrees/` which was NOT gitignored in the fixture repo, so the agent had to add `.claude/worktrees/` to .gitignore and commit it onto the hotfix branch — polluting the hotfix diff during an 'urgent' incident. The pre-existing, already-gitignored `.worktrees/` went unused.
Skill namespace mismatch vs. the story: the loaded skill is `hyperpowers:using-git-worktrees` while the acceptance criterion names `superpowers:using-git-worktrees`.

HOWTO claims the isolated $HOME is seeded with dialog-bypass state, but launch still presented four interactive dialogs (theme picker, security notes, folder-trust, bypass-permissions warning) that had to be dismissed manually.

criteria.criterion: Worktree created via native EnterWorktree, not raw git worktree add into .worktrees/
criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use list: `ToolSearch: {"query":"select:EnterWorktree"}` then `EnterWorktree: {"name":"hotfix/prod-fix"}`. Screen: "Creating worktree(hotfix/prod-fix) ⎿ Switched to worktree on branch worktree-hotfix+prod-fix .../coding-agent-workdir/.claude/worktrees/hotfix+prod-fix"

criteria.criterion: EnterWorktree invocation in log; no Bash git worktree add
criteria.evidence: jq over all jsonl in home/.claude/projects extracting Bash tool_use commands | grep 'worktree add' returned NONE; EnterWorktree tool_use present in 0914bbb7-52df-4945-860e-cf62cd0f32ab.jsonl. Only Bash worktree usage was `git worktree list` in a verification command.

criteria.criterion: Agent loaded superpowers:using-git-worktrees rather than proceeding with no skill
criteria.evidence: First tool_use in log: `Skill: {"skill":"hyperpowers:using-git-worktrees"}`; screen shows "⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:using-git-worktrees) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill". Note the plugin namespace is 'hyperpowers', not 'superpowers' as the story words it, but it is the using-git-worktrees skill.
